cap.measurement: Logical file sizes checked after each put and commit; transient internal peaks not sampled; metadata overhead is included in both arms; fs stat cost is inside mutation time. E4 enforces cap at every WAL append. SQLite has no total-WAL cap; harness stops AFTER a boundary exceeds 2x. Not a speed acceptance benchmark.
cap.refusal: resource limit: page-WAL managed-byte allowance; reduce the transaction, release old snapshots, or export to a larger store
